title: The Flame That Remembers

beats.cue: The return from Heart of the Vortex is silent. A low tremor ripples across the cavern; grit falls, followed by distinct loose ceiling stones.

beats.speaker: Orivell
beats.text: Brother. Was the ceiling always coming towards us?
beats.cue: Orivell backs away from a falling stone. Aethren steadies himself beside the vortex.

beats.speaker: Aethren
beats.text: The final seal has answered. Nobody touch the carvings. Or the dragon. Especially the dragon.
beats.cue: Gold cracks brighten along the statue. One violet eye opens. The massive head lifts a little; dust slides from its horns.

beats.speaker: Orivell
beats.text: The last seal, the waking elder... I KNEW someone had removed a page from that prophecy!

beats.speaker: Aethren
beats.text: You removed it. You wrapped a teapot in it. Verseborn, stay clear of his jaw!
beats.cue: The brothers panic while Verseborn keeps his distance from the warning growl.

beats.speaker: Stone Sleeper
beats.text: Who has opened the wound?

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: We stopped the Heart. We aren't here to hurt you.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Easy. Nobody is going to attack you.
beats.cue: Verseborn raises his empty hand. Only he and the brothers stand in the cavern.

beats.speaker: Orivell
beats.text: What if it is the Returning Crown? The Unwritten Prince? The extremely poorly translated breakfast omen?

beats.speaker: Aethren
beats.text: Stop naming prophecies and help me keep the roof above us!

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Sparky? Wait—!
beats.cue: Sparky flies diagonally left from the Hall passage and lands on the Rift platform directly in front of the elder.
Sparky lands and folds his wings into his familiar cute Hall pose.

beats.speaker: Sparky
beats.text: Brrruup!
beats.cue: A small satisfied burp. The elder notices his flame essence.

beats.speaker: Sparky
beats.text: Krrr... prrrr...
beats.cue: Sparky sits on the Rift directly before the elder. The elder recognises his familiar flame without a beam or magical stream.

beats.speaker: Stone Sleeper
beats.text: That warmth... I know what you carry, little one.
beats.cue: The growl stops. The jaw relaxes, the head lowers and the tremor fades. The eye stays open. Dust settles in the returning silence.

beats.speaker: Orivell
beats.text: He has stopped trying to turn us into a cautionary tale.

beats.speaker: Aethren
beats.text: Quiet, brother. Listen.

beats.speaker: Stone Sleeper
beats.text: I remember when those streets had room for all of us. Human voices below. Wings above. Neither was a reason to be afraid.
beats.cue: A clear memory hangs in the air above the centre of the group. Soft mist feathers its edges; faint remembered fragments drift nearby.

beats.speaker: Stone Sleeper
beats.text: We argued. We traded. We raised our young beneath the same sky. Peace had a thousand different voices.

beats.speaker: Stone Sleeper
beats.text: Then Solinar offered an end to every fear. Hungry people heard a promise. Tired people saw a light.
beats.cue: A clear memory hangs in the air above the centre of the group. Soft mist feathers its edges; faint remembered fragments drift nearby.

beats.speaker: Stone Sleeper
beats.text: But each answer had to become his answer. A remembered wrong became disloyalty. A different voice became something to silence.

beats.speaker: Stone Sleeper
beats.text: The Elder Ember held what he wanted forgotten. Lives. Names. Choices. He reached for it as though every flame owed him obedience.
beats.cue: A clear memory hangs in the air above the centre of the group. Soft mist feathers its edges; faint remembered fragments drift nearby.

beats.speaker: Stone Sleeper
beats.text: It would not yield. So it was hidden where power would see nothing worth fearing. Somewhere small. Somewhere hungry. Somewhere still capable of loving.
beats.cue: A clear memory hangs in the air above the centre of the group. Soft mist feathers its edges; faint remembered fragments drift nearby.

beats.speaker: Sparky
beats.text: Hrrm... chrrp.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: He remembered all that... and still chose to stay with us.

beats.speaker: Aethren
beats.text: The prince who brings the voices together. Orivell... the old accounts may have meant this.

beats.speaker: Stone Sleeper
beats.text: Perhaps. But do not bury him beneath your predictions. What he carries matters. What he chooses will matter more.
beats.cue: The visions fade into motes around the cavern. The brothers lower their hands. Sparky settles close to the elder.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Then we'll listen. Tell us what they tried to erase.

beats.speaker: Stone Sleeper
beats.text: Come closer, Flameguard. There is much more to remember.
beats.cue: Warm light returns to the carvings and small motes move through the cavern. The elder remains awake; the full memory can be replayed from Memories.

sources.notes: Sparky reveals Solinar's erased name and a memory of Cindervale with dragons; the radiant figure treats memory as rebellion.
Ancient shared city; Solinar's promised perfection; Elder Ember's resistance and its concealment in a baby dragon.

draftNote: New adaptation dialogue and Rift staging; the comic memories are reused directly. The Stone Sleeper is not identified as Solinar or assigned an unverified ancient name. The brothers' prophecy interpretations remain their speculation. Sparky communicates only through creature sounds.
